phase: pricing gate (stopped before any Adam step)

arms.treatment: N alignment structure x (selection CE + order-decoy margin, m = 1.0)
arms.control: N alignment structure x selection CE only

design.only_variable: the objective (margin term present or absent); structure, init, data order, LR, clip and update count are shared
design.decoy_rule: gold record key split at its character midpoint with the two halves swapped; byte multiset, byte length and byte inventory identical, only the order differs
design.margin_term: per example 2 content starts (object start 3 / place start 21), one order decoy each; loss = mean(relu(1.0 - (score_gold - score_decoy))); the decoy key is binding.base.relation.pool(binding.base.relation.encode_units(subject, decoy))

training.data_order: h.schedule(train, 30), identical batches for both arms

pricing_gate.note: the measured extrapolation exceeds the 800 CPU cap: training 445.31 + three full 192-example snapshots 289.03 = 734.34 floor, plus readings, save, closing price and report overhead, plus the 38.88 already spent, totals 812.12; nothing was trained and no bundle was written
pricing_gate.formula: estimate = 30*ce + 30*(ce+margin) + 3*snapshot + (after_reading + first_batch) + save_overhead + after_price + report_overhead + cpu_already_spent; no blanket safety factor because every component is a directly measured unit (the only extrapolation is the 24->192 decode slice)
pricing_gate.unit_method: one forward+backward per unit on batch 8; the prior run measured the same method twice and the second measurement was within 5% of the first, so a single reading is used and no blanket safety factor is applied
